questions.question: What is the caption of the cover illustration?
From which work is the cover illustration taken?
options: A Collection of the Dresses of Different Nations, Ancient and Modern
questions.answer: A Collection of the Dresses of Different Nations, Ancient and Modern
questions.explanation: The page names Thomas Jefferys' collection, published 1757–1772; the other titles are not mentioned.

questions.question: According to the page, what could people's dress reveal in earlier centuries?
questions.answer: Where they lived and what their trade or station in life was.

questions.question: Over which period was Jefferys' collection published?
questions.explanation: The page gives 1757–1772. 1568 is the date in the caption of the depicted costume, not the publication date.

questions.question: What does the book's first chapter, which begins on the next page, ask?
questions.explanation: Chapter 1's title, per the contents (PDF p.8); it starts on PDF p.25.
